call_points.text: Machine Tool Division expected to grow at 50% for the current year.
TMD margins hit by 'unprecedented' cost hikes in copper and electronics; no price pass-through yet.
ATC capacity utilization at 70%; composite segment seeing strong traction.
TMD order book is ₹3,200 Cr, of which ₹2,400 Cr is active; deliveries now run four to five years.
ATC margin was helped by a higher share of assemblies and by forex; management expects it to even out to last year's level.
The six new divisions, including pharma and specialty chemicals, are only an enabling resolution with no decision yet.
Machine tool division revenue is about 56% automotive this quarter; J-series machining centres are well accepted.
Management declined to answer whether it is winning orders from a competitor that exited the textile machinery market.
Machine tool division can grow revenue by 20% on existing installed capacity.
Half of FY26 capex was deployed in ATC division machinery.
Planning a new, larger facility for ATC outside town to expand beyond existing current site constraints.
Approved up to $30 million investment into UAE holding entity to back export opportunities and working capital.
ATC order book stands at ~₹360 Cr, to be executed over the next 18 months.
Imported content in Machine Tool division raw materials sits at around 50%.
ATC division revenue mix for FY26 stood at 22% composites and 78% metallics.

operating_notes.text: Consolidated Textile Machinery segment posted a FY26 loss of ₹16.32 Cr on revenue of ₹1,933.13 Cr, versus a ₹20.66 Cr loss in FY25.
Machine Tool & Foundry segment profit rose to ₹97.20 Cr in FY26 from ₹59.29 Cr, on revenue of ₹1,204.94 Cr.
FY25 other unallocable income included a ₹131.61 Cr gain on sale of subsidiaries in China and UAE to LMW Holding Limited.
Machine Tool division imports around 50% of its raw material inputs.
ATC division holds an order book of ~₹360 Cr for execution over 18 months.
TMD sales mix in Q1FY27 was 64% domestic, 10% exports and 26% spares.
ATC order book is about 25% composite and 75% metallics; current-quarter turnover was 20% composite and 80% metallics.
LMW Global (Dubai) Q1FY27 turnover ₹51 Cr with a ₹5.6 Cr loss and ₹22 Cr order book; LMW China turnover ₹11 Cr with a ₹7 Cr loss and ₹128 Cr order book.
Existing capacity 6,750 machines per annum at 90% utilisation; proposed addition 125 machines/month by December 2026 at ₹10 Cr.
H1FY27 operating cash flow was ₹280.84 Cr against EBITDA of ₹165.67 Cr.
Two subsidiaries not reviewed by the statutory auditor reported a net loss after tax of ₹26.46 Cr for H1FY27.
TMD active order book is ₹2,600 Cr; 70% are project orders.
MTD utilization is 75-80%; auto sector share is >50%.
ATC order book is ₹1,000 Cr; 70% metallics, 30% composites.
